guidelines.label: Community Guidelines
guidelines.title: A place for the messages unsent.
guidelines.intro: This is a space for grief, love, memories, goodbyes, and messages you could not send. To keep it respectful and safe, please follow these guidelines.
guidelines.whatText: You may leave a message for someone you lost, someone who left, someone you miss, or someone you can no longer reach. Messages can be emotional, personal, sad, loving, unfinished, or simple.
guidelines.dontPostPrivate: Private personal information about yourself or another person.
guidelines.dontPostDetails: Full names, addresses, phone numbers, emails, workplace details, or school details without permission.
guidelines.dontPostThreats: Threats, harassment, stalking, insults, or messages meant to shame someone.
guidelines.dontPostHate: Hate speech, discrimination, or dehumanizing language.
guidelines.dontPostExplicit: Sexual, graphic, violent, illegal, or exploitative content.
guidelines.dontPostSpam: Spam, advertising, links to scams, or repeated duplicate messages.
guidelines.respectText: This place is for expression, not revenge. It is okay to write about pain, grief, confusion, or love. It is not okay to use this space to attack, expose, threaten, or pressure another person.
guidelines.publicText: Messages left on the map may be visible to other visitors. Do not share anything you would not want strangers to read. If you write about a real person, avoid details that could identify or harm them.
guidelines.moderationText: Messages that break these guidelines may be hidden, rejected, or removed. Reports may be reviewed manually. A message may also be removed if it creates risk for someone’s privacy, safety, or dignity.
guidelines.harmfulText: If a message contains private information, harassment, threats, hate, or harmful content, please report it or contact us. Include enough detail so the message can be found and reviewed.
guidelines.strugglingText: This space can bring up difficult feelings. If you feel unsafe, overwhelmed, or at risk of hurting yourself or someone else, please reach out to someone you trust, local emergency services, or a crisis support service in your country.
guidelines.finalText: This place is for expression, not revenge. Please be kind. Leave words that need a place to exist, not words meant to hurt someone else.

legal.label: Legal
legal.title: Privacy, terms, and disclaimer.
legal.intro: This page explains how this website works, what information may be collected, and what you agree to when using it.
legal.aboutText: This website is a public space for unsent messages, memories, grief, love, and words people could not say directly. It is made for expression and reflection, not for private communication.
legal.publicText: Messages submitted to the map may be visible to other visitors. Please do not post anything private, identifying, harmful, or anything you would not want strangers to read. If you write about a real person, avoid details that could identify or harm them.
legal.collectText: When you leave a message, the website may store the text you submit, the names or labels you enter, the selected map location, and the date the message was created. If you contact us, we may store the information you provide so we can respond.
legal.useText: Submitted messages are used to display content on the map and to keep the website working. Contact information is used only to respond to messages, reports, or removal requests. We do not sell personal information.
legal.moderationText: Messages may be reviewed, hidden, rejected, or removed if they break the community guidelines, contain private information, or create risk for someone’s privacy, safety, or dignity. Reports may be reviewed manually.
legal.responsibilityText: By using this website, you agree not to post harassment, threats, hate, private personal information, illegal content, spam, or content meant to harm another person. You are responsible for the messages you submit.
legal.crisisText: This website is not therapy, counseling, medical advice, legal advice, or emergency support. If you feel unsafe, overwhelmed, or at risk of hurting yourself or someone else, please contact a trusted person, local emergency services, or a crisis support service in your country.
legal.changesText: This website may change, pause, remove features, or become unavailable at any time. These legal notes may also be updated as the website develops.
legal.contactText: For questions, reports, or removal requests, please use the contact page. Include enough detail so the relevant message or issue can be found and reviewed.

contact.label: Contact
contact.title: Get in touch.
contact.intro: Use this page for questions, feedback, reports, or removal requests. If something on the map feels harmful or private, please include enough detail so it can be found and reviewed.
contact.beforeText: For reports or removal requests, please mention what the message says, who it is addressed to, or where it appears on the map.
contact.crisisText: This form is not for crisis support. If you feel unsafe or at risk of hurting yourself or someone else, please contact local emergency services or a crisis support service in your country.
contact.success: Thank you. Your message has been received.
